To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
soymilk supplemented with whey protein concentrate (WPC70) and fermented with probiotic Lactobailli showed enhanced antioxidative activity, proteolysis and reduced polyphenol contents.
the addition of WPC70 to fermented soy milk increases the antioxidative activities and the proteolytic activities and reduces the polyphenol content of these six probiotics lactobacilli strains.
the antioxidative activity of soymilk is increased by supplementation with WPC70 and by fermentation with probiotic lacto-bacilli.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the antioxidative activity, polyphenol content, proteolysis, and growth of probiotic lactobaciili in fermented soy milk and soy milk with WPC70.
the development of a soy based probiotic food with health benefits.
the antioxidative properties of fermented soy milk supplemented by WPC70 using six probiotic cultures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the antioxidative activity of fermented soymilk supplemented with WPC70 by L. rhamnous C6 is significantly higher than that of other fermented soymilk by Lactobacillus cultures.

the addition of whey protein concentrates to fermented soymilk can improve the growth of probiotic lactobcilli, antioxidative activity, polyphenol content, proteolysis activity and the nutritional quality of fermented soy milk.
WPC70 supplementation to soy milk enhances the antioxidative activity of probiotic lactobaciili and thus can be used to develop functional food.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antioxidative activity of soymilk fermented by probiotic lactobaciilli is increased with the addition of WPC70.
the antioxidative activity of soy milk fermented by probiotic lactobcilli can be enhanced by WPC supplementation.

the antioxidative activity of soymilk fermented with L. rhamosus C6 is higher than that of unfermented soya milk, and the addition of WPC-70 to soymilk fermented by L. rhamnose C6 further enhances the antioxidative activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the antioxidative activity of fermented soymilk supplemented with WPC70 is higher than the antioxidative activity in unfermented and fermented soymilk.
soy based probiotic food is a good source for the production of bioactive peptides.
the use of WPC70 in soymilk fermentation with probiotic Lactobailli is a good alternative to improve the health benefits and nutritional value of soymilk.
